name: attestation
definition: A signed statement that an artifact was built and verified; its absence yields a Speculative epistemic level, never Proved.

name: data class
definition: An ontologically-typed data-side governance node (OntoDT/OntoDQ) binding a datatype-ontology class, a business glossary term, and a valid-values domain.

name: epistemic level
definition: The MEET of attestation and verification on a receipt — Proved, Speculative, or Refuted; recomputed by the validator, never merely declared.

name: governed loop
definition: A correction/convergence loop admissible only when bounded, convergent, fail-closed, and admitted by the superconscious; the only place a cycle is legitimate.

name: operational DAG
definition: The operational task graph carrying identity and dependency; it must be acyclic — a cycle is refused.

name: promote to platform
definition: Moving a catalogued dataset or document to platform scope, authorized only by an approved Data-Acquisition Request (the meet of governance and IP/legal review).

name: release gate
definition: A fail-closed check a service must pass to be release-ready; a gate that cannot fail is not a gate.
